question: Show all pairs of entertainers and customers who each have up to three style strengths or preferences, where the first and second style preferences of the customers match the first and second style strengths of the entertainers (or in reverse order). Only return the entertainer’s stage name and the customer’s last name
sql:
-- Build the matching query - fixed alias issue
WITH customer_prefs AS (
  SELECT CustomerID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_pref,
    MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_pref
  FROM Musical_Preferences
  GROUP BY CustomerID
  HAVING COUNT(*) <= 3
),
entertainer_styles_ranked AS (
  SELECT EntertainerID, StyleID, StyleStrength,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EntertainerID ORDER BY StyleStrength DESC, StyleID) as rank
  FROM Entertainer_Styles
),
entertainer_top2 AS (
  SELECT EntertainerID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_strength,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_strength
  FROM entertainer_styles_ranked
  WHERE rank <= 2
  GROUP BY EntertainerID
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
entertainer_count AS (
  SELECT EntertainerID, COUNT(*) as num_styles
  FROM Entertainer_Styles
  GROUP BY EntertainerID
  HAVING COUNT(*) <= 3
)
SELECT e.EntStageName, cu.CustLastName
FROM customer_prefs cp
JOIN entertainer_top2 et ON (
  (cp.first_pref = et.first_strength AND cp.second_pref = et.second_strength)
  OR (cp.first_pref = et.second_strength AND cp.second_pref = et.first_strength)
)
JOIN entertainer_count ec ON et.EntertainerID = ec.EntertainerID
JOIN Entertainers e ON et.EntertainerID = e.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers cu ON cp.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID
ORDER BY e.EntStageName, cu.CustLastName
